greeting: Naalagaaffiup, Ernerup, Anersaap Illernartup aqqani. Guuti, tassaasoq neriunneq aamma asanninneq, ilissinniissaaq.
penitential:
Naalagaq, saammaatigit.
Kristusi, saammaatigit.
Naalagaq, saammaatigit.
psalm_response: Naalagaq, Guuti angajoqqaatut, ilinnut tamarmik nersortipput.

Takorlooriartigu ullumi inuunermi takusinnaasatsinnik, ungasinngitsumilu pisimasumik. Takorlooriartigu Benjamin, meeraanerminiilli, aqqutini tamani misigissutsinik ammasuunini. Takorloorsinnaaviuk Benjamin Vo, inuunermini, inuunermik asannilluni, inuunermik qungujulalluni, aamma inuunermik kiffartuussilluni inuuvoq. Taassuma inuunera, ullumi, Guutip paarsisup asanninneranik takutitsivoq. Benjamin, inuunermini, inuunermik asannilluni, inuunermik qungujulalluni, aamma inuunermik kiffartuussilluni inuuvoq. Taassuma inuunera, ullumi, Guutip paarsisup asanninneranik takutitsivoq.

spiritual_communion: Naalagaq Jesus, upperaagit illit Eucharist-imi najuuttutit. Asavatsit tamatigut, kissaatigaaralu ilinnut ilaasutut inuunissara. Ullumi illit uummatinnut qaaqqissinnaanngikkaluarlutit, uummatinnut iserfigisutut tikilluaqqussavatsit. Ilinnut ilaasutut misigisaqarpunga, aamma ilinnut ilaasutut inuunissara kissaatigaara. Naalagaq, qitornatit, Benjamin, eqqaaguk, aamma uagut tamaasa ilinnut qanillutit.
closing: Guutip asanninnera uagut tamaasa ilissinniissaaq. Eqqissillusi inuugitsi.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mut, aamma toqusimasunut tamaginnut, Kristusip qaamanerani eqqissillutik inuunissaat qinnutigaarput.
Kikkulluunniit aliasuttunut, Guutip qiimmassarlugillu neriunermik tunissagai qinnutigaarput.

readings.label: Atuagassiaq 1
readings.text:
Uanga, Johannesi, qilammi takuara ilisarnaat alla, angisooq tupinnartorlu: inngilit arfineq-pingasut nappaatinik arfineq-pingasunik kingullernik, tassami taakkunatigut Guutip kamanneri naammassineqarmata.

Tassa takuara imaq assigisoq sajuppillattumik ikuallannermik akulimmik. Imaq sajuppillattoq ikuallannermik akulik qulaallugu nikipput taakku Guutip arpaannik arpaannik ajugaasut, uumasumut, taassuma assilissaanut aamma taassuma aqqanik nalunaaqutsiisumut. Guutip arpaanik tigummisaqarput, aamma erinarsorput Mosesip, Guutip kiffaata, erinarsuutaa aamma Savaraap erinarsuutaa:

“Angisooq tupinnartorlu tassaapput suliatit,
Naalagaq Guuti pisinnaassusilik.
Eqqortut aamma sallusuissut tassaapput aqqutitit,
O, naalagaaffiit naalagaat.
Kina ilinnik ersinngilaq, Naalagaq,
imaluunniit aqqit nersorlugu?
Ilit kisivit illernartuugavit.
Naalagaaffiit tamarmik tikissapput
ilittut ataqqinnillutik,
tassami eqqortuliornerit takutinneqarmata.”

readings.label: Evangelium
readings.text:
Jesus inuppassuarnut oqarpoq:
“Tigussavaatsit aamma malersussavaatsit, sinagoginut aamma parnaarussivinnut tunniutissavaatsit, aamma naalakkanut aamma naalagaaffiit naalagaannut siumut itisissavaatsit uanga aqqara pissutigalugu.
Tassaassaaq uppernarsaaneq. Eqqaamajuk, siumut illersornissat piareersassanngilatit, tassami uanga nammineerlunga tunissavakkit oqalunnermi ilisimasassat, akerlilersuisutit tamarmik akerlilersinnaanngisaannik imaluunniit itigartitsisinnaanngisaannik. Angajoqqaatit, qatanngutitit, ilaquttatit, aamma ikinngutitit tunniutissavaatsit, aamma ilissinni toqutissavaatsit. Uanga aqqara pissutigalugu tamarmik uumissavaatsit, kisiannili niaqqusi nujai ataasiinnaannguulluunniit aserorneqassanngilaq. Quleriinnermik inuunissit qulakkiissavatit.”

day: Wednesday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
